docs.text: Marie Curie discovered polonium and radium in 1898. She won two Nobel Prizes.
Public CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) disclosed in December 2021. Patched widely.
Ada Lovelace, born 1815, wrote the first algorithm intended for a machine.
Winston Churchill served as Prime Minister during World War II. His speeches are public record.
The city of Paris had a population of about 2.1 million in 2020. The Eiffel Tower opened in 1889.
